content.title: Point of Presence Locations
content.body: Please visit support.starlink.com or update your Starlink App to view this topic.
content.bodyMarkdown:
### Where are the points of presence for Starlink private network interconnect?
A private network interconnect allows you to connect directly with Starlink over a dedicated physical link. You must have presence at one of the data center facilities in the geography of your home point of presence
